description: A revenue center is a distinct business unit or location that generates revenue (e.g. a store location, a kiosk, an online channel). Every order is attributed to exactly one revenue center.

columns.name: tenant_id
columns.description: Tenant this revenue center belongs to

columns.name: name
columns.description: Display name of the revenue center

ddl:
CREATE TABLE text_to_sql_node.revenue_centers (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id UUID NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  region TEXT NOT NULL,
  opened_date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE
);
